## Brainlike contribution checklist

- [ ] YAML lives under `community/brainlike/<slug>.yaml`
- [ ] Validates against `community/brainlike/_schema.yaml`
- [ ] Has at least one entry in `predicates` and `examples`
- [ ] Includes `references` where applicable
- [ ] `id` is kebab-case and globally unique under `community/brainlike/`
